claim: PATCH /procurement/orders/:id is not a side door around the sealed acts, a price change on it leaves paper, and the two uncalled alert relays are closed (ADR 0244 D1, D2, D4; founder rulings 2026-09-29; 817-route audit at 5a20d774b, re-verified at c47fd8a01). (1) procurement.service.ts updateOrder refuses ANY dto.status with 422 reason status_through_its_act unless the caller already ran the transition (opts.statusTransitionAlreadyChecked, set only by cancelOrder), naming the act that makes the move (whereThisMoveIsMade); before, any member moved PENDING/APPROVAL_NEEDED/NEGOTIATING to APPROVED with no seal, no approval rule, no approved_by and no reservation, and reached REJECTED, FAILED, DELIVERED, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED the same way. The cancel refusal (cancel_through_the_sealed_act) is kept. (2) ORDER_MONEY_FIELDS (quotedPrice, negotiatedPrice, finalPrice, totalCost, priceVerified) require OrganizationsService.assertCanManageRestaurant(actor, house, change an order's price); an unwired helper is a 500 and an unnamed actor a 403, both before any write; the figures are read first (readOrderMoneyBefore, a failed read refuses) and every moved column is filed as order_price_changed in system_audit_log with from and to. The controller passes { actorUserId: user.userId } and never the cancel-only opts. No client sends this PATCH (git grep apps/web/src, apps/mobile, packages, services, scripts, apps/web/e2e, 2026-09-29): ordersApi.updateOrder/updateOrderStatus are uncalled, the legacy Mark as Ordered went with #494; this verify fails if a web or mobile file starts calling updateOrderStatus. (3) POST /communications/alerts/low-stock and /alerts/daily-summary are gone with resolveAlertTenant and DailySummaryDto (ADR 0149 answer 15 posture); no caller in apps, packages, services; ScheduledTasksService still sends both through CommunicationsService with house-register recipients and the tenant's own websocket room. D3 (re-check the limit on approved orders, ruled 2026-09-30) is NOT this claim: it lands with fix/order-price-recheck. Behaviour: order-patch-is-not-a-side-door.spec.ts (34 cases over HTTP, 27 red on c47fd8a01, 2 more red without the audit row), alert-relays-are-closed.spec.ts (5 cases, 4 red on c47fd8a01); 9 of 9 service/controller mutations killed. This verify: 16 reasons on c47fd8a01, and 10 of 10 tripwire mutations (cancel refusal, cancel-only opts, scheduled producers, a client relay call, an updateOrderStatus call, a dropped money field, an empty scan, the pre-read, the paper, the ADR) each reported, 2026-09-30.
